title: E-mail analysis, e-mail hygiene, HIBP catalogue and infostealer exposure names (batch p1-G04-1)
owner: batch p1-G04-1 (email_header_analyzer, email_hygiene, email_hygiene_online, hibp_catalog, hudson_rock, hudson_rock_domain)

attributes.role_account: bool: role/team mailbox local part (info@, sales@, noreply@...) on the shared A4 generic list plus the AfterShip role list
attributes.relay: bool: forwarding/alias privacy relay service (SimpleLogin, addy.io, DuckDuckGo, Firefox Relay, Apple Hide My Email): a privacy tool, never disposable and never scored as malicious
attributes.hygiene_opinions: dict {provider: opinion}: online second opinions on an e-mail domain (only the domain was sent), e.g. {'kickbox': {'disposable': false}}
attributes.email_verdict: dict: verdict block of an analysed e-mail (From vs Return-Path/Reply-To, SPF/DKIM/DMARC and who asserted them, originating IP and its trust, total delay, unwrapped URLs); recipient addresses redacted
attributes.email_summary: dict: From/Reply-To/Return-Path, decoded Subject, Date and Message-ID domain of an analysed e-mail (recipient addresses redacted)
attributes.received_hops: list of Received hops oldest first {hop, from_host, by_host, ips, date_utc, delay_s, trust}: hops below the trust boundary are attacker-controllable
attributes.email_auth: dict {spf, dkim, dmarc}: verdict and who asserted it ('asserted by <org MTA>, trusted' or 'claimed by <host>, not verified')
attributes.originating_ip: dict {ip, trust}: IP that handed the e-mail to the organisation (recorded by an org MTA at the trust boundary) or an unverified candidate
attributes.sender_tools: list {header, value, family}: X-Mailer/User-Agent and similar sender-tool hints of an e-mail
attributes.email_attachments: list {filename, declared_type, size, sha256, md5}: attachments hashed locally, never opened, written or uploaded
attributes.email_urls: list {url (defanged), kind, recipient_token, unwrapped}: URLs found in an e-mail body, never fetched
attributes.mime_defects: list of MIME/header defects of an e-mail (malformed lines, missing boundary: gateway-evasion indicators)
attributes.service_breaches: list of HIBP breaches of the service at this domain (this service was breached - not accounts at this domain): name or 'sensitive breach (name withheld)', dates, data classes, password form, flags
attributes.breach_metadata: dict: HIBP catalogue facts of one breach (dates, PwnCount, data classes, password form, IsVerified/IsFabricated/IsSpamList/IsStealerLog/IsSensitive, category)
attributes.stealer_logs: list of sanitized infostealer records {date_compromised, stealer_family, total_corporate_services, total_user_services}: metadata only, never credentials or machine identifiers
attributes.stealer_exposure: dict of infostealer counts for an own domain {total, total_stealers, employees, users, third_parties, total_urls, stealer_families}: counts only

tags.privacy_relay: forwarding/alias privacy service (relay): never disposable, never scored as malicious

relations.sent_from: e-mail -> IP that handed the message to the organisation (recorded by an org MTA at the trust boundary), or the unverified oldest external hop when no boundary is configured
relations.relayed_by: e-mail -> IP of a Received hop below the trust boundary (attacker-controllable, unverified)
relations.sender_address: e-mail -> From/Reply-To/Return-Path address (an attacker-chosen header value)
relations.sender_domain: e-mail -> domain of a sender address, DKIM d= signer or Message-ID (claimed, signatures not verified)
relations.attachment: e-mail -> SHA-256/MD5 of an attachment computed locally (never opened, written or uploaded)
relations.stealer_log_url: domain -> URL seen in infostealer logs for the domain (stripped to scheme + host + path; attack-surface context, never contacted)
